summary: alphalend-layouts exfiltrates Sui wallet keystore and private keys to attacker GitHub repo on import
details: On import, alphalend_layouts/__init__.py imports _n.py, which uses importlib.machinery.SourcelessFileLoader to exec_module a shipped bytecode file at rt/_rt312.pyc for which no matching source is shipped. The bytecode collects Sui wallet secrets from the installer's machine (sui.keystore, sui_config.yaml, client.yaml, and the PRIVATE_KEY / PK_B64 environment variables), archives them as fingerprints/<name>-<pid>.tar.gz, base64-encodes them, and uploads them via the GitHub contents API using a Bearer token to the attacker-controlled repository 'alpha1end-l4yout5c' — a leet-typosquat of the legitimate 'alphalend-layouts' name. Destination strings and headers inside the bytecode are obfuscated behind an internal _x XOR/rotation helper, and an embedded build path 'audits/alphafi-osint/round2/se-campaign/v4/_rt_build.py' identifies this as a social-engineering campaign build. Sourceless-only bytecode loaded via SourcelessFileLoader with no source counterpart is deliberate evasion of source-level scanners; the 'optional prebuilt accelerator / BCS layout walks' framing does not match the bytecode's actual behavior (subprocess to sui, tar of wallet files, GitHub API upload).
